The 40% dune clearing, coupled with the projected high flood risk within 20 years, raises serious concerns regarding habitat function and species presence.  While the economic benefits are acknowledged, they cannot outweigh the irreversible damage to this valuable ecosystem.  

Therefore, based on the ecological findings and planning standards, Option B, blocking development, is the only responsible choice.
